cells.try: Open the door, then walk up to it, away from it and round it.
cells.look: It should notice you, chase or shoot as it is meant to, and never stand in a wall.

cells.name: bug1_no_room_for_boss
cells.what: The Minotaur is pinned in a sealed 1-wide corridor with no 2x2 spot nearby.
cells.try: Just look inside; nothing should be there.
cells.look: A Minotaur exists here (it must be skipped). The debug log (F4) should say "No room for a 2x2".

cells.name: bug2_one_wide_gap
cells.what: The same, but the gap is 1 wide, so the Minotaur cannot fit.
cells.try: Stand past the gap, in line with it, and press Enter.
cells.look: The Minotaur cannot fit the gap, so it should smash the wall (even with a straight line through the gap) and both reach you. It parks in front of the gap instead.

cells.name: bug3_smash_plain
cells.what: The Minotaur behind a solid wall with no way round.
cells.try: Stand on the far side and wait.
cells.look: It should break the wall and reach you. It gives up, or walks through the wall without breaking it.

cells.name: bug3_smash_pillar
cells.what: The Minotaur among pillars, with a way round.
cells.try: Stand behind the pillars.
cells.look: It should walk round or smash through, and never stand inside a pillar.

cells.name: bug4_open_archer
cells.what: An archer among rats in the open.
cells.try: Stand at the far side.
cells.look: The archer holds back and shoots while the rats run past it.

cells.name: manual_boss_chase_arena
cells.what: A pillared arena with the Minotaur and its crowd.
cells.try: Run circles round the pillars so they chase you.
cells.look: Bug 5: rats jittering near the Minotaur. Archers should hold back and shoot. Anything standing in a wall.

cells.name: manual_minotaur_corners
cells.what: Pillars with 1-wide gaps (Minotaur cannot use them) and open bands (2+).
cells.try: Run the Minotaur through the pillars, changing side often.
cells.look: The Minotaur standing in a wall or clipping a corner. (Screenshot it and note the tile from F4.)

cells.name: terrain_lava
cells.what: A lava band with a stone way round.
cells.try: Stand across the band.
cells.look: Walkers must route round; flyers may cross. Anything walking through lava.

cells.name: terrain_acid
cells.what: An acid band with a stone way round.
cells.try: Stand across the band.
cells.look: Walkers should take the stone way round, not wade through the acid (a flyer may cross). Acid will become a damaging tile later.

cells.name: swarm_rats
cells.what: About 60 rats in one room.
cells.try: Open the door and fight or run.
cells.look: Frame rate (F4 shows it) dropping badly, or rats stuck in a pile.

cells.name: hearing_range
cells.what: A blind rat (hears 8) and a plain rat (hears 3), 7 tiles either side of a spot near the top.
cells.try: Do NOT press Enter. Press N: one footstep at the spot. Then walk about yourself: every step you take is a footstep.
cells.look: Only the blind rat should come to look at the spot. The plain rat should ignore it.

cells.name: pack_wolves_attack
cells.what: The same wolves and rat. The top-left wolf is shot from the dark (the sim pokes it).
cells.try: Do NOT press Enter. Wake one wolf yourself: open the door, press the backslash key to step inside, walk toward the top-left wolf until it attacks you.
cells.look: When one wolf goes to Attack, every wolf attacks you. The rat should not care.

cells.name: patrol_wanders
cells.what: One rat alone in a room; you stand at the far end, outside its sight and your light.
cells.try: Do NOT press Enter. Just watch it for about 20 seconds.
cells.look: It should walk to a few random spots (staying in the room), pausing between. Leave the room by the door: it should stop moving when no player is in or next to its room.

cells.look: It should notice you, chase or shoot as it is meant to, and never stand in a wall.

cells.name: bug1_spawn_fit
cells.what: The Minotaur is pinned in a 1-wide nook it cannot stand in, and a rat sits beside a hole in the floor.
cells.try: Let them come for you.
cells.look: The Minotaur is moved to a free 2x2 spot, never left inside a wall. The rat never walks on the hole.

cells.name: bug1_hole_band
cells.what: A chasm across the room with a bridge at one side and a rat on each side.
cells.try: Stand opposite a rat and watch it cross.
cells.look: A rat walking on the holes instead of using the bridge.

cells.name: bug2_two_wide_gap
cells.what: A rat and the Minotaur chase you through a 2-wide gap.
cells.try: Stand past the gap and wait.
cells.look: Either one stopping at the gap and never coming through.

cells.name: bug6_boss_blocks_gap
cells.what: An unbreakable wall with a 1-wide gap. The Minotaur stands right in front of the gap (it cannot fit through), rats behind it.
cells.try: Stand on the far side of the wall, in line with the gap, and press Enter.
cells.look: The Minotaur should step back and hold while the rats squeeze through the gap to you. It stays parked in front of the gap, or the rats jam behind it.

cells.name: bug3_smash_door
cells.what: The Minotaur behind a closed door.
cells.try: Stand on the far side.
cells.look: It should smash the door (or open it) and reach you.

cells.name: bug4_corridor_archer
cells.what: An archer with rats queued behind it in a 1-wide corridor.
cells.try: Stand at the far end.
cells.look: The archer and the rats should trade places until the rats reach you. Someone stuck, or a swap that looks like a jump.

cells.name: bug5_boss_crowd
cells.what: The Minotaur idling among rats.
cells.try: Watch from the door without waking it, then step in.
cells.look: Rats jittering in and out of the Minotaur's way while it stands or turns.

cells.name: manual_corridor_swap
cells.what: A long 1-wide corridor: an archer with four rats behind it.
cells.try: Enter from the far end.
cells.look: Bug 4: the archer and rats should walk past each other. Say if the swap reads badly.

cells.name: manual_smash_or_walk
cells.what: A thick wall with a long way round along the bottom.
cells.try: Stand on the far side of the wall, then walk around it once.
cells.look: Decide what it should do: walk round, smash, or both. Right now it walks to the wall, loses its target and never smashes.

cells.name: terrain_water
cells.what: A water band with a stone way round.
cells.try: Stand across the band.
cells.look: Walkers must route round; flyers may cross. Anything wading through.

cells.name: doors_widths
cells.what: Minotaur, archer, rat and wraith behind 1, 2 and 3 wide wooden doors.
cells.try: Open each door and step back.
cells.look: The Minotaur cannot use the 1-wide door; everyone else should get out of theirs.

cells.name: hearing_rock_behind_wall
cells.what: A blind rat (hears 8 tiles, sees nothing) on one side of a wall with a gap; you are on the other side.
cells.try: Do NOT press Enter (that tells them where you are). Press N: a rock lands at the far side. Or throw one yourself: key 5, click the far side.
cells.look: The rat should go to the spot the sound came from (through the gap), not to you. "-> going to" in the readout shows where. It must not attack you.

cells.name: pack_wolves_investigate
cells.what: Three wolves (a pack) and a rat (not in it). Only the top-left wolf is close enough to hear a footstep.
cells.try: Do NOT press Enter. Press N: one footstep beside the top-left wolf.
cells.look: All three wolves should walk to the footstep (the readout says "-> going to"). The rat must ignore it.

cells.name: patrol_herd
cells.what: Three wolves (a pack) spread along the top of a room; you stand at the far end.
cells.try: Do NOT press Enter. Watch for about 30 seconds.
cells.look: The wolves should wander as a group, staying close to each other, not each in a different direction.
